data_fields.donor_constant: site skipped when count_loaded_chunks > 0 (civilians and birds only; monsters not gated)

best_idea: A zone director keeps one count per kind of living plus waiting NPCs, queues each death as a ticket, replaces it only after a delay with a per-run budget, drops tickets over cap, and places only where no player is present.
decision_why: The ledger-plus-ticket shape fits zone population, but Veloren caps come from world generation, its delay is in in-game days, and its monster placement ignores loaded areas (TODO), so each must change for Frankendom.
acceptance: A server test in a zone with cap 6 and respawn 90 s asserts that after all 6 die with no player inside the zone radius, none are alive at once, the first replacement appears no earlier than 90 s after its death, no replacement appears within the radius of a standing player, and living plus waiting never exceeds 6.
